sources.supports: Some catalases have peroxidatic activity with ethanol as H donor; distinguish ethanol oxidation from principal catalase dismutation.
Oshino et al 1973 rat liver catalase peroxidatic ethanol oxidation quantified versus H2O2 generation; DOI10.1042/bj1310555. Not a W29 or compartment experiment.
Reaction(2) OAA to pyruvate+CO2 is an explicitly defined side activity; EC1.1.1.38 is not a mismatch merely because NAD is absent from this side reaction.
Exact OAA/pyruvate/CO2 identity, EC1.1.1.38/40 and4.1.1.112; printed reversible arrow does not establish physiological reverse flux.
Sender et al 2004 purified L.lactis CitM OAA decarboxylation; no malic activity; supports distinct activity class not native Yarrowia GPR.
Na-coupled OAA decarboxylation has explicit Na transport absent from actual model column.
Pyruvate carboxylase couples carboxylation to ATP; this coupling is absent from actual model column.

decisions.R_CAT2p: Supported conditional direction candidate LB0 retaining ethanol+H2O2 to acetaldehyde+2H2O. Never describe as reverse oxygen/water peroxide synthesis. Mixed cy/pe compartments and native GPR exact peroxidatic activity remain unresolved.
decisions.R_OAADCm: Supported exact removal of product H for preserved neutral pyruvate/OAA convention; supported conditional direction UB0 retaining OAA decarboxylation. Existing ionic Rhea/UniProt proton convention cannot be copied unchanged into neutral representation. Physiological concentrations/DeltaG and native precise activity unverified.
decisions.R305_R1889: Documented current H/charge residuals -2/-2 and -1/-1 only; no chemical correction or CoQ gate override. Lack of a new energy witness would not validate their latent chemistry.
